items.source: elementType - the expected type of elements in the output stream; this type must have been previously passed to the Decoder.canDecode(ResolvableType, MimeType) method and it must have returned true.
items.translation: elementType - 输出流中元素的预期类型；此类型必须已先前传递给Decoder.canDecode(ResolvableType, MimeType)方法，且该方法必须返回true。

items.translation: inputStream - 要解码的 DataBuffer 输入流

items.translation: mimeType - 与输入流关联的 MIME 类型（可选）

items.translation: hints - 关于如何进行解码的附加信息

items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only decodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose decoders without conflicts. Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅解码带有@Serializable注解的类型（在类型或泛型级别），因为它允许与其他通用解码器结合使用且不会发生冲突。可以使用带有Predicate<ResolvableType>参数的替代构造函数来自定义此行为。

items.source: By default this is set to 256K.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 256K。

items.source: Return the list of MIME types supported by this Decoder. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canDecode(elementType, null). The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use Decoder.getDecodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
items.translation: 返回此 Decoder 支持的 MIME 类型列表。该列表可能不适用于所有可能的目标元素类型，因此调用此方法时通常应通过 canDecode(elementType, null) 进行防护。该列表也可能仅包含特定元素类型支持的 MIME 类型。或者，使用 Decoder.getDecodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) 获取更精确的列表。
